title: Relation Queries and Pagination
description: Query related data efficiently using relation filters and paginate relation results.

data.text: Prisma relation filters let you filter parent records based on properties of their related records. Combined with pagination, you can build efficient APIs for nested data.
Relation filters use the `some`, `every`, and `none` operators to filter based on related records.

data.title: Relation Filter
data.content: Find users who have at least one published post.

data.text: You can paginate nested relations by applying `take` and `skip` inside an `include` clause.
